interface.signature: def longestSubstring(s: str, k: int) -> int

preconditions.expression: isinstance(s, str) and all(c.islower() for c in s)
preconditions.description: The input string s consists of lowercase letters only.
The integer k is greater than 0.

postconditions.expression: return_value == len(max((s[i:j] for i in range(len(s)) for j in range(i + 1, len(s) + 1) if all(s.count(c) >= k for c in set(s[i:j])), key=len, default=''))
postconditions.description: The function returns the length of the longest substring where every character appears at least k times.
